sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.what_it_does: Companies listed on the US stock market. Card 'US stock market (SEC)'; needs SEC_CONTACT_EMAIL in .env.

sources.name: SAM.gov
sources.what_it_does: Companies registered to sell to the US government. Card 'US government register (SAM.gov)', US sellers only; needs SAM_GOV_API_KEY (10 lookups a day on a basic key).

sources.name: State company registers (Secretary of State)
sources.what_it_does: Official company registers, one website per state.

sources.name: Better Business Bureau
sources.what_it_does: Business rating and complaints. No public API.

sources.name: Local chambers (GrowthZone / ChamberMaster)
sources.what_it_does: Chamber membership: thousands of local chambers (USA, Canada, UK...) use this directory software, so one Google search (Serper) finds a member page '/list/member/...'. Card 'Chamber of commerce'; asked for US sellers and sellers with no country file.

sources.name: Trade fairs (Map Your Show, ASD Market Week, MAGIC, CES)
